title: Reports
seo: Amazon seller reports on sales, fees and ads
meta: A plain Amazon report on sales, fees, returns and ad spend, with a clear list of next steps. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Amazon reports you can read in five minutes
overview: We pull data from your Seller Central business reports, fee statements and advertising console and turn it into one clear report. You see sales, units, fees, returns, ad spend, ACoS and what you keep, with best and slowest products and traffic and conversion by item. Each chart has a sentence of explanation and each report ends with three actions. We use only your own account data, so nothing is estimated from outside.

pkgs.blurb: One month of sales, fees and ad spend explained.
Two months compared, with traffic and conversion by item.
Three months of trends, with a profit view and a review call.

faq: Business Reports, payment and fee reports, FBA reports and advertising reports from your account. Access with reporting permission is enough; we need no ability to change listings or settings.
Can you include my product costs?
Yes. Send a sheet of your cost per unit and we show profit per product. Without it, the report shows net revenue after Amazon fees and ad spend, and says so clearly.
Does the report tell me what to change?
Yes. Three actions close each report, each linked to a number. If the data is too thin to support a decision, we say so, so you do not act on noise.
Is it a one-off or monthly?
A one-off report in a fixed package. A monthly report can be quoted separately, in the same layout, so months are easy to compare.
